svg.title: Tiro for Obsidian
svg.desc: Record in Tiro, sync summaries and transcripts as Markdown, and connect meeting notes in your vault. Feature overview, not an app screenshot.

g.text: Your meeting notes. In your vault.
Bring summaries and transcripts into the place you think.
Search, link, and build on them.
Tiro account required · Recording controls require Tiro desktop 4.12.1+
